engine.rule_crashed: This rule hit an internal error during analysis.
security.hsts.missing: The site does not send a Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header.
security.hsts.short_max_age: HSTS is present but its max-age is too short.
security.hsts.remediation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' to your HTTP responses.
security.spf_record.not_applicable: No MX record was detected, so SPF does not apply.
security.spf_record.missing: The domain receives mail but publishes no SPF record.
security.spf_record.ok: An SPF record is published for the domain.
security.spf_record.remediation: Add a TXT SPF record beginning with 'v=spf1' to the sending domain.
security.xfo.missing: No clickjacking protection found (neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors).
security.xfo.covered_by_csp: Clickjacking protection is provided via Content-Security-Policy.
security.xfo.remediation: Add 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN' or a CSP 'frame-ancestors' directive.
rgpd.cookie_consent.tracking_without_cmp: Analytics/advertising cookies are set with no consent banner detected.
rgpd.cookie_consent.cmp_present_needs_ma: A consent management tool was detected, but a manual check of the consent flow is recommended.
rgpd.cookie_consent.no_tracking_detected: No non-essential tracking cookie detected before consent.
rgpd.cookie_consent.remediation: Defer non-essential cookies until explicit user consent (see CNIL guidelines).
rgpd.mentions_legales.found: A legal notice page was detected.
rgpd.mentions_legales.remediation: Add a legal notice page linked from the footer, as required by French law (LCEN art. 6).
perf.compression.unrecognized: A non-standard compression encoding is used.
perf.compression.remediation: Enable gzip or brotli compression server-side (e.g. Express 'compression' middleware).
